mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies around City Hall at 66 degrees. The overnight low will be 59 degrees with no rain predicted. For you star gazers, the space station will be visible tonight starting at 9:56 PM for two minutes, rising in the West Northwest over Cross Plains and heading toward the Northeast near the Madison Home Depot.

In city news, the Verona Police Department is accepting applications for a free nine-week Citizen Academy, while City Hall has posted various election notices and maintains updated engineering reports from their contracted partners at AECOM.

There is plenty to do, starting today with Yoga at Insight Wellness and trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow features live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, the Saturday Dane County Farmers Market is on the square, and the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival takes over our streets this Saturday.
On Sunday, August 30, the Verona Police Department began an investigation that resulted in the arrest of a Madison resident for an inappropriate relationship with a student that occurred in 2019.
Today's flavor is the rich Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 51 minutes, so make sure to get there before they lock the doors.
